messages.subject: For Yam Kum Weng | Aviation infrastructure, country partnerships and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Changi Airport Group Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Yam Kum Weng, Chief Executive Officer.

Changi Airport Group's aviation-infrastructure and international partnership agenda requires disciplined alignment across governments, aviation authorities, security agencies, communities and operating partners. That interface is highly relevant to the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, including coordination with aviation and other public authorities in a complex operating environment.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, aviation coordination and country stakeholder strategy might support Changi Airport Group's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Changi Airport Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
